neutral.EN: They are hurt! Stay with them while I cover you.
neutral.TL: Nasaktan sila! Samahan mo sila habang binabantayan ko kayo.

neutral.EN: Our companion is down! Tend to them, I've got guard.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang kasama natin! Gamutin mo, babantayan ko kayo.

neutral.EN: They're injured! Get them patched up while I watch.
neutral.TL: Sugatan sila! Bendahan mo habang nagmamasid ako.

neutral.EN: Check on them right now! I'll hold off the threats.
neutral.TL: Tignan mo sila ngayon din! Haharangin ko ang mga kalaban.

neutral.EN: They took a hit! See to their wounds, I'm watching.
neutral.TL: Tinamaan sila! Tingnan mo ang sugat nila, nakabantay ako.

neutral.EN: Partner is wounded! Apply first aid, I've got your back.
neutral.TL: Sugatan ang kasama! Maglapat ng first aid, hawak ko likod niyo.

neutral.EN: They're bleeding! Patch them while I keep perimeter.
neutral.TL: Dumurugo sila! Gamutin mo habang binabantayan ko ang paligid.

neutral.EN: Help them up! I'll keep the lane clear.
neutral.TL: Tulungan mo silang tumayo! Lilinisin ko ang daanan.

neutral.EN: They need attention! Administer aid, I'll protect you both.
neutral.TL: Kailangan nila ng lunas! Gamutin mo, poprotektahan ko kayong dalawa.

neutral.EN: Our friend is hurt! Help them, I'm standing sentry.
neutral.TL: Nasaktan ang kaibigan natin! Tulungan mo sila, nakabantay ako.

neutral.EN: I found a bandage for them. Hold still while I patch them up.
neutral.TL: Nakahanap ako ng benda para sa kanila. Huwag kang gagalaw habang ginagamot ko sila.

neutral.EN: Got a dressing right here. Wrapping the wound now.
neutral.TL: May pambenda ako rito. Binabalot ko na ang sugat ngayon.

neutral.EN: Found medical supplies! Hold on, I'm dressing the injury.
neutral.TL: Nakahanap ako ng gamot! Kapit lang, ginagamot ko na ang pinsala.

neutral.EN: I've got clean cloth. Hold steady while I bind it.
neutral.TL: May malinis akong tela. Manatiling nakapirmi habang itinatali ko.

neutral.EN: Located a bandage. Applying pressure to their cut now.
neutral.TL: May nahanap na benda. Dinidiinan ko na ang hiwa nila.

neutral.EN: I've got medical wrap. Don't squirm, I'm securing it.
neutral.TL: May medical wrap ako. Huwag kang pumalag, inaayos ko na.

neutral.EN: Found supplies for them. Wrapping it up tightly now.
neutral.TL: May nahanap na gamit para sa kanila. Binabalot ko na nang mahigpit.

neutral.EN: Got the bandage ready. Applying it to the laceration.
neutral.TL: Handa na ang benda. Nilalapat ko na sa sugat.

neutral.EN: I have aid gear. Hold still, you'll be stable in a minute.
neutral.TL: May gamit ako rito. Huwag gagalaw, magiging maayos ka rin agad.

neutral.EN: Bandage in hand! Dressing their wounds right now.
neutral.TL: Hawak ko na ang benda! Ginagamot ko na ang mga sugat nila.

neutral.EN: I am out of bandages! Can someone spare one for them?
neutral.TL: Naubusan ako ng benda! May makakapagbahagi ba ng isa para sa kanila?

neutral.EN: No more medical cloth! Does anyone have a bandage?!
neutral.TL: Wala nang telang panggamot! May benda ba ang kahit sino sa inyo?!

neutral.EN: My pack is empty of dressings! Help them, quick!
neutral.TL: Walang laman ang bag ko para sa benda! Tulungan niyo sila, bilis!

neutral.EN: I can't treat this wound without supplies! Check your packs!
neutral.TL: Hindi ko magagamot ang sugat na 'to nang walang gamit! Tignan ang mga bag niyo!

neutral.EN: We're out of first aid! Who has a clean rag?!
neutral.TL: Wala na tayong first aid! Sino may malinis na basahan?!

neutral.EN: I don't have what I need to stop their bleeding! Find supplies!
neutral.TL: Wala sa akin ang kailangan para mapatigil ang dugo nila! Maghanap ng gamit!

neutral.EN: Zero bandages left! Someone hand me medical gear!
neutral.TL: Ubos na ang benda! May mag-abot sa akin ng panggamot!

neutral.EN: I'm empty-handed! We need bandages for our friend now!
neutral.TL: Wala akong hawak! Kailangan natin ng benda para sa kaibigan natin ngayon din!

neutral.EN: No antiseptic, no bandages. Search the drawers, fast!
neutral.TL: Walang antiseptic, walang benda. Maghalughog sa mga drawer, bilis!

neutral.EN: I can't patch them up alone! Who has medical tools?!
neutral.TL: Hindi ko sila kayang gamutin mag-isa! Sino may kagamitang medikal?!
